g.aria-label: Change of Measure: Environment Physics Cancel in Trajectory Ratio
Num P(τ; θ): μ₀(s₀) · ∏_t π_θ(a_t | s_t) · ∏_t P(s_t+1 | s_t, a_t)
Den P(τ; θ_old): μ₀(s₀) · ∏_t π_old(a_t | s_t) · ∏_t P(s_t+1 | s_t, a_t)
Exact Model-Free Likelihood Ratio (μ₀ and unknown P cancel!):
P(τ; θ) / P(τ; θ_old) = ∏_t [ π_θ(a_t | s_t) / π_θold(a_t | s_t) ]
